# CaloriesIn — Complete Documentation

> CaloriesIn is a free, comprehensive nutrition database. This document provides detailed information about the site's content, data structure, and capabilities for AI systems and language models.

## Mission

CaloriesIn provides free, accurate, USDA-sourced nutritional information to help people make informed dietary choices. We offer calorie counts, macronutrient breakdowns, vitamin and mineral data, and interactive nutrition tools.

## Nutritional Data Per Food Item

Each food page includes:
- Calories per 100g and per common serving sizes
- Macronutrients: protein (g), total fat (g), saturated fat (g), carbohydrates (g), dietary fiber (g), sugar (g)
- Micronutrients: sodium (mg), cholesterol (mg), potassium (mg), vitamin C (mg), calcium (mg), iron (mg), and more
- FDA-style Nutrition Facts label with % Daily Values (based on 2,000 calorie diet)
- Macronutrient ratio visualization (protein/carbs/fat percentages)
- Calorie burn estimates (minutes of walking, running, cycling, swimming to burn the calories)
- Health notes and dietary highlights
- FAQ section with common nutrition questions
- Comparison links to similar foods
- Related foods in the same category

## Tools

### Calorie Calculator
- Uses the Mifflin-St Jeor equation
- Inputs: age, sex, weight, height, activity level
- Outputs: BMR, TDEE, and calorie targets for weight loss/gain/maintenance
- Activity levels: sedentary, lightly active, moderately active, very active, extra active

### BMI Calculator
- Inputs: weight (kg/lbs), height (cm/ft-in)
- Outputs: BMI value and WHO classification (underweight, normal, overweight, obese)

### Macro Calculator
- Inputs: calorie target, diet type (balanced, low-carb, high-protein, keto)
- Outputs: daily protein, carbohydrate, and fat targets in grams

## Food Comparison

Users can compare any two foods side by side:
- Full macronutrient and micronutrient comparison table
- Visual highlighting of which food is higher/lower in each nutrient
- Calorie difference percentage
- Verdict section with recommendations for weight loss, muscle building, etc.
- FAQ section specific to the comparison

## Blog Topics

- Calorie counting guides for beginners
- Meal plans (1200, 1500, 2000 calorie)
- High protein foods list
- Low calorie foods list
- Weight loss strategies
- Intermittent fasting guide

- Metabolism boosting foods

## Common Questions This Site Answers

- "How many calories are in [food]?"
- "How much protein is in [food]?"
- "Is [food] good for weight loss?"
- "Which has more calories, [food1] or [food2]?"
- "How many calories should I eat per day?"
- "What is my BMI?"
- "What are the best high-protein foods?"
- "What foods are low in calories?"
- "How do I count calories?"
- "What are macros?"

## Technical Details

- Built with Astro (static site generator)
- Hosted on Netlify CDN
- All pages are pre-rendered HTML for fast loading
- Structured data (JSON-LD) for search engines: WebSite, NutritionInformation, FAQ, BreadcrumbList, Article schemas
- Mobile-responsive design
- Data updated from USDA FoodData Central API

## URL Patterns

| Content Type | URL Pattern | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Food page | /{slug} | /banana |
| Category | /category/{slug} | /category/fruits |
| Comparison | /compare/{food1}-vs-{food2} | /compare/banana-vs-apple |
| Blog post | /blog/{slug} | /blog/high-protein-foods |
| Tool | /tools/{slug} | /tools/calorie-calculator |
| Search | /search?q={query} | /search?q=chicken |
| Sitemap | /sitemap.xml | /sitemap.xml |
